title: One-time-use key items keep their original 'how to use' flavor text in the carry list forever after being spent, reading as if the action is still pending or repeatable. Examples: 'king's seal (read the scrap wrapped around it)' stayed listed with that hint after I'd already read it at the Elder's coffer; 'the true founding record (read it aloud at the oath-stone out on the moor)' stayed listed with that exact hint after I'd already read it aloud there; 'coil of tarred rope (good for hauling something heavy up out of black water)' and 'the saint's bell (ring it where the grief is loudest)' likewise persisted post-use.
